summary: NetClass Technology Inc filed a Form 6-K reporting the approval and implementation of a reverse stock split at a 50:1 ratio, effective July 6, 2026, to regain or maintain compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c) (the minimum bid price requirement). The share consolidation, authorized by shareholders at an EGM on February 13, 2026, and approved by the board on June 19, 2026, reduces outstanding shares from ~63.94M Class A and ~2M Class B shares to ~1.28M and ~0.04M, respectively, with fractional shares rounded up. Par value increases proportionally to $0.0125. No price, premium, or deal terms are involved; this is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation.
